checkpoint: P8B provenance-bearing task resource context boundary
purpose: Validate the smallest product boundary that can carry trusted task resource provenance after P8A. The boundary accepts an explicit versioned list of caller-owned file resources, supports only an exact current-document role in this initial scope, requires absolute paths, fails closed on unsupported or ambiguous input, performs no UI/filesystem/perception discovery, and can derive the already validated P7E pulsar-document caller context from one explicit Pulsar current-document resource. This session does not wire taskResourceContext into runTask yet.
requiredClaims: task resource context is explicitly versioned and bounded
the initial supported resource shape is kind=file + role=current-document + application + absolute path
relative paths, unsupported resource kinds/roles, unsupported versions and oversized contexts fail closed
more than one current-document resource for the same requested application is ambiguous and fails closed
one explicit Pulsar current-document resource derives exactly one pulsar-document caller context with the same caller-owned path
a current-document resource owned by another application does not derive Pulsar caller context
the resource provenance boundary performs no Computer Control, semantic snapshot, OCR, Vision or filesystem discovery
taskResourceContext is not yet wired implicitly into the default agent loop or CLI
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This session is not a physical UI validation.
This session does not prove the path refers to an existing file or current UI document; runtime surface preconditions remain responsible for binding execution to the actual surface.
This session does not infer provenance from window title, semantic snapshot, OCR, Vision, filesystem probing, planner output or coordinates.
This session does not wire taskResourceContext into runTask or the default CLI.
This session does not add a generic file-open capability or generic Pulsar fallback.
P7E remains PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED at the explicit pulsar-document caller-context boundary.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P8C wire explicit taskResourceContext into normal runTask as a third mutually exclusive caller source, derive the already validated P7E caller context only from explicit resources, preserve default CLI no-context behavior, and contract-test before physical validation.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact product/test contract mismatch, fix forward, and create s02.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: No screenshot bytes, OCR payload, document contents, visual coordinates or user file paths are required by this contract-only session.
